translations.web: You shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord Yahweh.’
translations.bsb: And at My table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, of mighty men and warriors of every kind,’ declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: And ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord Jehovah.
